_comment: Alias 'docs' -> qwen2.5:3b on planning: writing from artifacts, few commands. The alias is resolved in endpoints/config.yml; this file never names a server. Never set native_tool_calling true on an unverified model - see endpoints/toolcheck.py. api_key is the literal throwaway loopback value, NOT os.environ/: OpenHands does not expand environment references in this field. Sending the literal string makes LiteLLM attempt a virtual-key lookup, which without a database returns 400 'No connected db.' on every turn while /v1/models still answers - it looks like a model fault. This key is safe to commit only because every port is bound to 127.0.0.1; it must be changed if the proxy is ever exposed.
